# External SMW Tools

This directory is for local, ignored tool clones:

- `pixi/` - `https://github.com/JackTheSpades/SpriteToolSuperDelux.git`
- `asar/` - `https://github.com/RPGHacker/asar.git`
- `AddMusicKFF/` - `https://github.com/KungFuFurby/AddMusicKFF.git`

Closed-source or download-only tools such as Lunar Magic and GPS are documented
in [../../docs/external_tools.md](../../docs/external_tools.md) rather than
vendored here.
